end.summary:
Defined food miles as the distance food travels from farm to plate.
Compared local spinach/apples with food brought from farther away.
Explained that longer journeys may use more fuel and refrigeration/electricity.
Calculated 220 + 90 = 310 kilometres.
Gave 6 unaided correct responses out of 7 attempts; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Rohan practised defining food miles, comparing local and distant foods, and linking transport distance with fuel and refrigeration costs. They first gave a brief answer, “the orchard to your plate,” and later corrected it with the complete farm-to-plate definition. At home, ask them to choose two foods and estimate which has more food miles, explaining why.
